The easier it is to get insurance policies from insurance companies, the more difficult it is to get claims from them. Many policy holders complain that the insurance company is reluctant to pay the claim amount. But here, as much as the fault is of the companies, almost as much is also made by you. We are saying this because people make many mistakes while taking the policy, due to which they face difficulty in getting the claim. For example, taking the terms and conditions lightly, not reading and understanding their details properly, etc. For example, taking the terms and conditions lightly, not reading and understanding their details properly, etc. That's why let's know what mistakes can be made while taking health insurance and how to avoid them. So let's know which 5 things are important to keep in mind while taking health insurance.
